# Session Six

## Plan

- Company land at Inis Ocular to gather the levy and carry out various other things they want
- [Mentha the Mint](/cast/the_emerald_lights.qmd#mentha-the-mint) is worried about this promised child


## Landing

- The company enter the keep and are immediately brought to The Shield Knight
    - She feeds them and dotes on The Leaf Knight
    - Tells them she is being blackmailed by Mentha the Mint
- The company sleep in the tower
- Silk & Leaf talk to Mentha in the observatory (top of tower)
    - Mentha complains about the power the knights horde and refuse to share
- Story and Salt rile up the public at the port in pubs
    - They find the boatsmen (Alfonsino, Bream, and Dace who help)
    - Acquire 2 militia warbands to attack the fortress
    - However memebrs of the Emerald lights over hear and alert the fortress
- Silk and Leaf inquire at the clerks about finances but they are very cagey
- The fortress goes into lockdown
    - Silk and Leaf locked in their shared room in the observatory tower with 2 guards positioned outside

## The Child's uprising

- The Salt Knight approaches the front of the fortress with no one but a lutier
    - Mentha along with 2 bowed skirmisher warbands wait on the walls at the gate
    - Also mercenaries in the walls and 1 skirmisher warband at back on walls
    - Salt and Lutier mock the Emerald Lights enraging Mentha
    - The Skirmishers open fire and Mentha unleashes the Mercenaries to chase Salt
    - Salt uses her fire sword to light the spiralled row of birch trees alight
    - This harms and temporarily traps the mercenaries allowing Salt to successfully escape
- Story finds out about a cave system from the Boatsmen which they descend into to try to attack the fortress from below
    - This is actually the ossified guts of the red serpent
    - They find their way to a treasure room and Story tries to get them all to continue
    - However, he loses half of his forces to greed
- Silk and Leaf try to escape and end up in a fight with the 2 guards
    - A prolonged fight ensues
    - The Guards cry for help and then shortly "surrender"
- Story emerges out into the wine cellar of the observatory tower.
    - A butler joins the militia and gives Story a bottle of incredibly string alcohol
- At the ground level Story hears a warband of skirmishers approaching the main door
    - He ambushes them and hacks the majority of them to pieces with his milita
- Mentha sees this form the wall and gets angrier and angrier
- Story, Salt, Silk, and Leaf all join together on the ground floor of the tower
- The Shield Knight comes in round the side of the tower to join
- Mentha tells the knights to surrender of skirmishers will open fire upon The Shield Knight
- Story refuses by killing the rest of the skirmisher forces at the tower
- Shield knight gets shot, fine but fatigued
- Silk shoots Mentha who takes the hit and falls off the wall to the outside
- Story throws a molotov over the wall hitting Mentha who is badly burned
- However, the mercenaries arrive and put out the fire
- Salt and Leaf join The Shield KNight and protect her from another barrage of arrows
    - They try to escaoe to cover around the tower but The Leaf Knight can't make it
    - She is shot down by another barrage and is slain
    - However, she continues to breath after her death rattle
    - But she sees her mother, The Shield Knight, lying dead instead. She used her ability to be slain instead.
- Mentha and her mercenaries get the outside gate open and enter the "airlock"
- Through the inner portcullis Teh Silk knight leading the militia manage to destroy most of the mercenary war band who try to feebly fight back
- Burnt and demoralised Mentha surrender
- The Leaf Knight spares Mentha and the knights have won in the name of the promised child
